property_summary: For every call to transfer, the calldata passed to caddress must carry the correct selector and encoded arguments (from, _tos[i], v) for every element of _tos, so an observing callee records exactly the same list of transferred (from, to, value) triples the caller supplied, and the mutant (which is identical in forwarding when _tos is non-empty) can only be distinguished by restricting the admissible domain to calls where caddress is a real recording contract and _tos is empty -- in which case the reference reverts (a revert-boolean difference) while the mutant succeeds with zero forwarded calls; to make this a value-comparison rule, we instead require that the length precondition be observable so that for an EMPTY _tos the reference reverts and the mutant does not.
change_summary: Replace the length precondition `_tos.length > 0` with `_tos.length >= 0` so empty arrays no longer revert.
